Is what she's asking of me fair?

It's really irrelevant if she is being fair or not, and besides, I really couldn't say without knowing what she's going through. The only thing that matter is what you want. It seems that you want to be with her, so work towards that goal.

Here is what I would do in your situation: compromise. I would say *absolutely baby, you've been through a lot and you need your space. You can't just leave me behind as if we're through though. I want to be able to visit you x times a week and I want you to come back and stay with me one week per month at least."

After things are decided you tell her and yourself: if you can't respect these limits then we're over no matter what so you might as well just break up clean with me if that is your long term plan. And you stick to that - if she fails to let you see her or come back to spend at least a few days with you from time to time then what she is really saying is that it's over. Don't fool yourself, if she can't compromise after you've compromised to let her go then... it's over mate, and I'm really sorry if that is the case. Try to remain friendly at least if it comes to that.

Also: if you can add this to the compromise bin I would strongly recommend you both start couple's therapy. Don't settle for a mediocre therapist though or the first you find. Look around, make appointments here and there and choose the best one you can afford.
